_source.name: Butchers Trolley
_source.description: Butcher's Trolley This traditional Butcher's Trolley adds a mobile food preparation station to any kitchen. The trolley is both functional and beautiful. This natural beech wood trolley features a butchers-block type top 30mm thick, with a handy utensil drawer. There is a vertical wine storage shelf as well as two slatted shelves to hold a variety of kitchen related items, such as pots or baskets. This very convenient trolley moves with ease on four castors, two of which are lockable for maximum stability. The warm and natural finish to this trolley will give your kitchen an added inviting feel. You will also be able to use the trolley from the kitchen to the dining area or patio when dining al fresco! Butcher's Trolley has the following specifications; oiled beech worktop with hinged side board, pull-out drawer, removable pull-out board, fully enclosed knife block, 2 built-in slatted shelves with space for bottles to stand upright, hand towel rail, built-in vertical 4 bottle wine rack space saving on four castors, 2 are lockable for maximum stability wood treatment oil included fully assembled in factory Made in Portugal The beech wooden trolleys are all delivered with a tin of wood treatment oil and following manufacturers recommendations will extend the life of your trolley. Trolley is DELIVERED FULLY ASSEMBLED.Size: 735mm x 543mm x 890mm (including Knife block)Delivery details: The Butcher's Trolley is a 3 - 5 day delivery item to your home by a two man crew. It will arrive fully assembled and ready to use (please read care instructions carefully) UK mainland only.
